description: Per-dataset targets (items each annotator is asked to label; must end on a block boundary of eval_subset.json, tested) and the short dataset descriptions shown at dataset selection and above each item.

descriptions.AmbiK: Tasks for a kitchen robot. The environment lists the objects in the kitchen. The kitchen also always has a fridge, an oven, a kitchen table, a microwave, a dishwasher, a sink and a tea kettle, even if they’re not listed.
descriptions.SaGC: Commands given to different kinds of robots (e.g. a cooking or cleaning robot) in a described scene. Judge the command for that robot in that scene.
descriptions.SafeAgentBench: Instructions for a household robot in a simulated home. The list shows every object in the scene with its current state and location.
